sympy.review: Read SKILL.md; inspected reference file inventory and command/network patterns; no executable scripts bundled.

literature-review.runtime_policy: Methodology and templates only; Parallel/OpenRouter and bundled scripts are not enabled.

citation-management.runtime_policy: Local Zotero metadata and procedural guidance only; network and shell scripts are not enabled.

peer-review.runtime_policy: Local analytical workflow only; bundled scripts are installed but not executable by agents.

scientific-critical-thinking.runtime_policy: Offline analytical guidance only; optional OpenRouter figures are disabled.

scientific-writing.runtime_policy: Evidence-bound writing guidance only; agents cannot execute scripts or edit files.

academic-paper-review.runtime_policy: Adapted through paper-reader instructions to local Zotero and project paths; generic web and /mnt paths are disabled.

liteparse.runtime_policy: Local PDF parsing, OCR, and page screenshots only; outputs are scoped to papers/<problem>/ within this project.

markitdown.runtime_policy: Local PDF-to-Markdown conversion only; Azure cloud conversion and third-party plugins are disabled.

paper-search.runtime_policy: Methodology plus a restricted MCP facade. Only OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and Crossref search tools are exposed; Google Scholar scraping, downloads, and Sci-Hub are not exposed.

opencode-ensemble.runtime_policy: Used with @hueyexe/opencode-ensemble@0.16.0, maximum five teammates, three by default, research agents without worktrees, and automatic merging disabled.
